title: Shift-first billing + clear action guides
summary: Print and Pay, Hold, refunds, and cash drawer now require an open shift and explain why when blocked. After this update, staff see a short guide of what changed.
highlights: Open shift first: Print and Pay shows a clear modal when shift is closed (Open shift CTA)
Hold and Void/Refund use the same shift gate so Z-report stays accurate
Cash drawer and pay-in/pay-out also prompt to open shift instead of failing silently
Print and Pay explains empty cart, short cash, and unbalanced split - no dead button
After update install: Whats New + optional 4-step tour of shift and billing UX
